scientific_integrity: Universal identities have a complete analytic proof; finite exact-rational checks are supplementary, not infinite certification. No independent audit or external validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Single-point noiseless Euclidean risk for a cubic odd component plus an even differentiable component; no result for general higher odd remainders, evaluation noise, algorithm convergence, or implementable derivative-free radius tuning. Bibliographic originality remains conditional on specialist prior art.
title: Exact cubic-jet risk and finite-radius optimum for orthogonal finite differences
